fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the execution of SOAPHound, a .NET tool for collecting Active Directory data, using specific command-line arguments that may indicate an attempt to extract sensitive AD information.
fields.name: HackTool - SOAPHound Execution
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains " --buildcache " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " --bhdump " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " --certdump " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " --dnsdump ") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains " -c " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " --cachefilename " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " -o " or tgt.process.cmdline contains " --outputdirectory")))
